arStrings.szText: {c_important}Rabies'{/c} Poisoning damage also increases over the lifetime of the disease, dealing {c_number}[{SF_14}*100|%x|]{/c} bonus damage at max duration.

{c_important}Rabies{/c} becomes a {c_important}Core{/c} Skill, costs costs {c_resource}{if:Mod.Upgrade4}[SF_36-SF_14]{else}[SF_36]{/if}{/c} Spirit, and has no Cooldown.

{c_important}Rabies{/c} spread can reinfect enemies who already have the disease up to {c_number}[SF_27]{/c} times per cast.

{c_important}Rabies{/c} becomes a {c_important}Core{/c} Skill, costs {c_resource}{if:Mod.Upgrade4}[SF_29-SF_14]{else}[SF_29]{/if}{/c} Spirit, and has no Cooldown.

{c_important}Rabies{/c} deals {c_number}[SF_28*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage but only spreads to one target a time.

{c_important}Rabies{/c} deals its full damage after {c_number}[SF_38 * (Mod.Upgrade2 ? SF_3 : 1)]{/c} seconds as Direct Damage to the target. This Direct Damage gains {c_number}[SF_39*100|+%|]{/c} ({c_number}[SF_40*100|+%|]{/c} while {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c}) bonus Critical Strike Damage.
{c_important}Rabies{/c} deals its total Poisoning damage {c_number}[SF_3*100|%|]{/c} faster.
Enemies that die while affected by {c_important}Rabies{/c} will heal you for {c_number}[SF_15*100|%|]{/c} Maximum Life.
